newsitem.title: UK: Japan stocks ease in London, holiday muted trade.
newsitem.headline: Japan stocks ease in London, holiday muted trade.

text.p: Japanese shares drifted lower London on Monday with a one day holiday in Japan keeping a cap on activity, traders said.
"There's been a bit of retail interest in things like the steels," said one trader based in London.
"But overall it has been very quiet as people have had a long weekend," he said.
London's Nikkei/ISE 50 index ended the day 0.60 lower at 1413.75, down 0.04 percent on the day.
In Tokyo on Friday, the 225-share Nikkei Average index closed up 398.71 points, or 1.95 percent.
